entities.summary: Chinese Han, a notable figure in the history of Kyrgyzstan, associated with Ancient Tian Shan Cultures (800 BCE–200 BCE). Preceded by Saka and Wusun Confederations and Petroglyphs and Bronze Age Settlements. Their legacy influenced Zhang Qian's diplomatic mission contacts the Wusun around Issyk-Kul.
